semantic_findings.accrued_expenses: OtherAccruedLiabilitiesCurrent is retained as a diagnostic but rejected as an exact XACC equivalent.
semantic_findings.deferred_revenue: Total ContractWithCustomerLiability is used directly for DRC+DRLT, avoiding current/noncurrent double counting.
semantic_findings.prepaids: No narrow PrepaidExpenseCurrent fact; broader other-current-assets facts are not substituted.
semantic_findings.sga_rd: R&D is a sibling expense outside reported SG&A; XSGA is reconstructed as reported SG&A plus R&D, so XSGA-XRD equals reported SG&A and R&D is not double-counted.

limitations: Mechanical tag presence is not CbOP semantic equivalence and is never a scoreability verdict.
Company Facts omits custom and dimensional facts and cannot prove statement/calculation relationships.
A missing standard tag is unknown, never zero.
Current Submissions SIC is not historical PIT SIC; raw accession headers are required.
Current sample ticker labels are not historical CIK-to-security mapping evidence; as-filed DEI class/title/symbol plus entity lifetime is required.
A full accession-package census is intentionally not authorized by this pilot result because external long-only/concentration gates independently reject the design.
